messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "store tightly closed at room temperature away from moisture, heat, and light"
set: ["store tightly closed at room temperature away from moisture, heat, and light", "store at room temperature away from moisture, heat, or cold temperatures", "store at room temperature away from moisture and heat", "store tablets and capsules at room temperature away from moisture and heat", "store the oral liquid at room temperature and keep it in a tightly closed bottle", "store made-up suspension at room temperature", "store at room temperature away from moisture and heat and out of reach of children", "keep away from heat and light", "store away from children", "store tablets at room temperature between 68°F and 77°F (20°C to 25°C) in original closed bottle", "may be kept at room temperature", "protect from heat and light", "protect from light", "store in the refrigerator or at room temperature up to 86°F (30°C)", "store in dry place away from moisture", "pen can be stored at controlled room temperature"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "store at room temperature away from moisture, heat, and light",
    "store at room temperature away from moisture and heat",
    "store tablets and capsules at room temperature away from moisture and heat",
    "store the oral liquid at room temperature and keep it in a tightly closed bottle",
    "store made-up suspension at room temperature",
    "store at room temperature away from moisture and heat and out of reach of children"
  ],
  "alias": "store at room temperature away from moisture and heat"
}
